crew.overview: The story of the onset of the HIV-AIDS crisis in New York City in the early 1980s, taking an unflinching look at the nation's sexual politics as gay activists and their allies in the medical community fight to expose the truth about the burgeoning epidemic to a city and nation in denial.
crew.title: The Normal Heart

details.biography: Gary Megregian, MPSE, is a Supervising Sound Editor at Technicolor Sound Post Production. Originally from Detroit, Mich., he graduated with a BA in Communication from Michigan State University. After working in Audio Post Production in the Detroit he relocated to Los Angeles in 2001. Since then, he has worked on American Horror Story, American Crime Story, Feud, Glee, The Normal Heart, Pose, Scream Queens and Hollywood. Gary recently finished the second season of The Politician and the feature The Boys In The Band for Netflix. Gary has won two Primetime Emmy Awards and received six additional Emmy nominations, as well as two MPSE Golden Reel Awards with an additional seven nominations. He is currently working on the upcoming Netflix feature The Prom.
details.name: Gary Megregian
